title: [CQ-C00] Preserve complete UTF-8 CLI tool responses
description: Objective: fix the real Moe CLI response transport truncation/corruption observed during rollout auditing. Final Node parser in scripts/moe-call.sh writes then forces process.exit before pipe drain; Buffer-chunk concatenation also corrupts split UTF-8. Daemon-free fake-proxy evidence: >1.2MB response cut to65,536 bytes with exit0; regular-file Unicode gained replacement characters. Two independent controls show both fixes required. Deliverable: actual-helper large/Unicode/error regressions, minimal parser fix, permanent cross-platform CI command. NOT in scope: proxy changes, Python prerequisite cleanup, response budgeting, task semantics or arbitrary new CLI features. Verification: node --test scripts/tests/moe-call.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs; bash -n scripts/moe-call.sh. Never edit real .moe; temporary test fixture dirs may simulate daemon discovery only. Preserve old exit0/exit1 and short legacy behavior.

Large structured content, raw/bare results and JSON-RPC errors roundtrip complete data with correct exit codes and no UTF-8 replacement.
Parser decodes stdin with streaming UTF-8 and permits all output to drain without forced immediate process exit.
Short legacy responses, malformed response failure and shell-sensitive/Unicode content remain correct.
Fresh named Node gate plus Bash syntax pass; permanent CI invokes the new harness.
taskRails: Exactly scripts/moe-call.sh, new scripts/tests/moe-call.test.mjs and CI command; no proxy or unrelated cleanup.
